On Tuesday, our class had an English lesson in a new classroom. The teacher put a large card on the board. Its title was “Word Game”. Each student took a pencil and a small paper sheet from the desk. I wrote the first word carefully, but I made a spelling mistake. My friend Mia showed me the correct spelling. Then we read seven words aloud and drew a circle around the longest one. At the end, the teacher collected the sheets. I put my pencil in my pencil case and took my textbook home. The lesson was comfortable and fun, and I want to practise again tomorrow.
